purpose: Frozen, duplicate-free inventory of every route formerly exposed by the retired Python Typer and Bash shctx implementations. Native routes are owned by the Rust CLI; retired routes remain listed as explicit non-implementations.

config: typed configuration is resolved through the one Rust schema; dotted reads and structured output never invoke the retired raw Python parser
configuration creation is descriptor-safe, no-clobber, and requires explicit confirmation
coordination: signal and teammate routes use project-scoped typed registry state, bounded input, deterministic ordering, and no tmux, inbox, shell, or harness-private fallback
doctor: health checks are read-only, emit a typed text or JSON report, and do not bootstrap Poetry, virtualenvs, or retired namespace state
home: the separately-owned user home contains only direct canonical shepherd configuration candidates and mutation requires explicit confirmation
init: native init requires explicit confirmation and creates only typed layout-v5 project state without Poetry, virtualenv, refresh, or retired directory scaffolds
seed: usage names the one public shepherd CLI instead of the retired shctx dispatcher
input is bounded to 1048576 bytes and read failures fail closed
shell-style path globs preserve ranges, parent components, hidden-file rules, and dangling directory entries without invoking Bash
handoff: canonical artifacts are read from runs/<run>/handoff.md; docs/handoffs is legacy read-only input during migration
knowledge: query exposes a fixed typed allowlist and search uses bounded canonical-registry FTS; neither route accepts shell substitutions, arbitrary SQL files, or unbounded input
locks: native lock operations use the canonical project lock and typed registry history, validate a closed mode vocabulary, and reap only a holder proven dead by the native PID probe
migration: native migration is a descriptor-safe layout-v5 plan or explicitly confirmed snapshot-backed rewrite; dry-run never mutates legacy inputs
planning and reports: audit, discovery, close-lane, render, and report leaves consume canonical run or typed-registry state without retired roots, subprocesses, network calls, or a second report authority
sprint execution: ready and lint validate canonical typed state in-process; sprint transitions are locked run-ledger updates and never hide refresh, git, worktree, or cleanup subprocesses
deliverables and issues are project-scoped because the typed registry schema has no run_id field; the CLI does not invent one in an unrelated column
run layout: layout-v5 creates only the canonical lanes tree and does not recreate retired graph/dispatch/reports/audits placeholders
run wave pending: exit 6 includes a deterministic stderr reason instead of failing silently

retirement_contract.launcher_policy: exec the native binary only; no interpreter, package manager, or legacy command fallback
retirement_contract.oracle_policy: former implementation roots are absent from the release tree; expected bytes and this route inventory are the only retained migration evidence
